tree.heading: Animal
tree.text: The term “animal” has the meaning given the term in section 8302 of this title.

tree.heading: Transboundary disease
tree.text: The term “transboundary disease” has the meaning given the term in section 8914(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Veterinary countermeasure
tree.text: The term “veterinary countermeasure” has the meaning given the term in section 8302 of this title.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 116–260, div. P, § 1, Dec. 27, 2020, 134 Stat. 2159, provided that: “This division [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘National Bio and Agro-Defense Facility Act of 2020’.”
